claim: The day counter goes up at dawn, as the dial's sun appears, not at sunset or midnight. The night face still belongs to the day before.

evidence.reference: Local agent playtest, 26 October 2026: research repo kellan/outlanders2-research, branch codex/playtest-observations (commits 572d8eb, 45125e9, 4b3a6c7), docs/INFORMATION-ANSWERS.md entry "Visible day counter increments at dawn (A2, boundary observation)". Screenshots: gameplay-evidence/clock/ (clock-2-early-night, clock-2-late-night, clock-3-sunrise-counter-increment).

notes: Screenshots bracket the change by about 10 to 15 real seconds. This places the visible day boundary; it does not by itself say which stored shift fraction is dawn. The decoded dial shows its day face for the first half of each day, so a day starting at dawn fits.
